title: 116 MPH - Speeding Mom with Kid on Revoked License – Escalates Traffic Stop!
description:
On April 19, 2024, New Mexico highway patrol officers clocked a white Dodge sedan speeding at 116 mph in a 75 mph zone. The officers promptly initiated a traffic stop, pulling the car over.

What seemed like a routine stop quickly escalated when 30-year-old Rodriguez refused to cooperate with officers, declined to identify herself, and repeatedly demanded to speak to a supervisor. It was soon discovered that Rodriguez was driving on a revoked license and had a minor in the car with her. Despite her non-cooperation, officers handled the situation professionally. They arrested Rodriguez and ensured the child’s well-being, offering water and snacks while arranging for family members to pick him up. Rodriguez was charged with speeding and driving on a revoked license.
